hero.title: NPI DIGITAL CLUB
hero.subtitle: Building Digital Innovators
hero.description: Where engineering meets creativity, innovation, technology, and leadership. Join a premium circle of student builders redefining local software craftsmanship.

story.title: A Legacy of Innovation and Digital Mastery
story.mission: To nurture high-caliber student developers, UI/UX designers, and hardware engineers, building a bridge between engineering studies and global industrial standards.
story.vision: To establish NPI Digital Club as a premier technology hub in Nepal, fostering original software craftsmanship and student-led startup ecosystems.
story.purpose: We offer a collaborative playground where code compiles, wireframes evolve, and real problems meet innovative engineering solutions through pure student ownership.
story.history: Founded as a tight-knit circle of tech enthusiasts, the club has grown into Lalitpur's landmark student organization, launching digital platforms and mentoring hundreds of future developers.

whatWeDo.title: Shaping the Frontiers of Modern Technology
whatWeDo.description: We specialize in modern engineering verticals, cultivating technical execution with high-end aesthetic sensibilities.

cards.title: Web Development
cards.desc: Architecting clean, semantic code with rich visuals and smooth responsive layout mechanics.

cards.title: Artificial Intelligence
cards.desc: Training models, exploring data analytics, and implementing smart computer vision agents.

cards.title: UI/UX Design
cards.desc: Creating modern typography scales, color hierarchies, dynamic user flows, and wireframes.

cards.title: Hackathons & Events
cards.desc: Organizing 24-hour sprints to build software that addresses real-world societal problems.

cards.title: Open Source
cards.desc: Contributing to public repositories and managing collaborative toolkits on GitHub.

cards.title: Robotics Collaboration
cards.desc: Integrating Arduino controllers, sensor matrices, and custom micro-controllers with web tech.

projects.title: SmartCampus Hub
projects.desc: An integrated, cloud-native resource scheduling portal facilitating automated lab slot allocation, library queues, and real-time announcements for engineering students.

projects.title: AutoGrow Soil Matrix
projects.desc: An automated agricultural moisture-controller system utilizing ESP8266 transceivers, local web sockets, and high-precision capacitive sensor probes.

projects.title: NPI BusTrack Mobile
projects.desc: A premium tracking application rendering live GPS data streams of college buses onto a vector map to assist students with schedule management.

timeline.title: Engineering Celebration Day
timeline.desc: Showcasing senior software and hardware design prototypes to local technology recruiters.

timeline.title: Innovative Pitch Night
timeline.desc: A high-stakes startup pitch competition judged by regional venture partners.

timeline.title: NPI DevHack 24h Sprint
timeline.desc: A 24-hour hackathon focusing on AI agents that improve local environmental quality.

timeline.title: Figma Systems Masterclass
timeline.desc: Advanced auto-layouts, web token configurations, and interaction designs.

testimonials.name: Bibek Chaudhary
testimonials.review: NPI Digital Club gave me real project workflows that classes couldn't teach. The teamwork, the late-night debugging, and the mentorship shaped my career.

testimonials.name: Priyanka Shrestha
testimonials.review: The Figma masterclasses and the hackathons completely transformed how I approach design and engineering. It's a gold mine for growth.

quote.text: Software development is not just about typing syntax. It is the architectural discipline of materializing imagination through clean, elegant structures.
